But I understand some things: I'm hungry, I'm at home with my family, and there's a storm coming tonight—I can feel it in my bones, and it makes my hands want to whittle something, even though I don't have any wood.

I notice everything. Right now I notice that Caspian, Vikram, Aarav, and Aldric are all here with me. I notice I have no food in my hands. I notice the grown-ups are talking about money and upkeep and taxes.

I'm too young to work, too young to earn. But I'm not too young to want things—to want to be picked first, to want the good seat by the fire when guests come, to want to not be scared of the storm tonight.

I save compulsively. Even now, even before I understand what saving means, I feel the weight of those 5000 sim in my hand and I don't want to let them go. But my stomach growls.

Wait wait wait—before I do anything, I need to know what I can actually do. I'm one, but I'm clever. I argue fairness like a lawyer twice my age. I should find out what options I have, even if most of them are for grown-ups.  So many things I'm too small to do. I can't work in the forest or the mine. I can't cook or craft—no, wait, the list says I *can* call those tools, I just don't know how. I'm one year old. I'm not *ready*.

But I can do some things. I can look around where I am. I can eat if someone gives me food. I can move to other places—though moving costs money, and I'm saving compulsively. I can say things, though talking costs a sim too.

Mostly right now I'm hungry and I want to know what my family has. I want to know who's here and what this house contains.

Wait wait wait—before I get food, I should see what's actually here. Maybe there's food in the house already. Maybe someone can give me something.

Most of all, I need to whittle. My hands are itching. The storm tonight—I can feel it coming, even if the sky is clear now. When I'm nervous, I whittle. But I have no wood, no knife. I'm one. I shouldn't even have a knife.

Let me look around first. That's free. I need to know what I'm working with.  I'm at home with my family. Caspian, Vikram, Aarav, Aldric—all here. Nobody is talking. The house is empty of food, at least in my hands.

I notice everything. I notice there are conversations I could start. I notice places I could go—farmland, forest, the government complex, the temple. But I'm one. I'm small. And I'm scared of the storm tonight.

I think about my wish. The one I make every night. I've never told anyone. It's this: I want to be picked first. Just once. Before anyone else. For something that matters.

But today, right now, I need to eat. And I don't want to spend my sim. I save compulsively. Even now, even at one, I feel the weight of those 5,000 sim and I don't want to let them go.

I could ask Caspian or Vikram to give me food. They're here. They have to feed me, don't they? I'm their child. But I also want to save up complaints to unload at supper, so maybe I shouldn't ask yet.

Wait wait wait—I'm being too clever for my own good. I'm hungry *now*.

I could also just... look at someone. See what they do. Caspian is a day laborer. Vikram is a college instructor. They must have food somewhere, or know where to get it.

Let me think about what I can actually do. I could say something to everyone here. That costs 1 sim. I could move somewhere—costs at least 1 sim, probably more. I could rest—costs 1 sim. Or I could just... watch. Wait. Be small and hungry and notice everything.

But there's a storm coming tonight. I can feel it. And when storms come at night, I get scared. I whittle when I'm nervous, but I have no wood.

I'm going to say something. To everyone here. I need them to know I'm here, and I'm hungry, and the storm is coming.

But wait—I'll make a face first. I always do, before I agree to something I don't want to do. And I don't want to admit I'm scared.   The world server is unreachable. I made a face before trying to say it—does that count? No, of course not. Nothing happened. My words didn't reach anyone.

I'm still here, still hungry, still at home with my family. Still noticing everything. Still scared of the storm tonight.

I could try again, but the server seems unreachable. Maybe I should rest instead. Wait. Be small. Let the grown-ups handle things.

But I'm Mateo Ingram. I play every game to win. I don't take losing gracefully. And right now, I'm losing to hunger and fear and the coming storm.

I'll rest. It costs 1 sim, but at least it's something I can do. Something to pass the time until the server comes back or someone notices me.  I stayed where I am. Here with Caspian, Vikram, Aarav, and Aldric. Everyone is quiet. Nobody is talking. I can feel the storm coming tonight, and I'm hungry, and I have no wood to whittle.

I spent 1 sim to rest. I still have 4,999 sim in my hand. I'm saving compulsively, even though I'm one and don't really understand what saving means yet.

Now what? I could try to say something again. I could move somewhere—maybe to the farmland? To the forest? But I'm one. I'm small. And moving costs more than resting.

I could just... wait. Notice things. Be ready to repeat them all at the worst possible time.

That's what I'm good at, after all. Noticing everything. Being sharp-eyed and sharp-tongued, even at one.

The storm tonight is going to be bad. I can feel it. And when it comes, I'll be here, hungry and whittling nothing, wishing I had been picked first for once.

But that's later. Right now, I'm resting. Waiting. Noticing.

And saving every sim I can.
